post.description: Authorize file metadata and create resumable Asset upload capabilities.
Attach already-uploaded immutable Asset revisions to Knowledge.

Delete several documents in one transaction.

Same policy as single delete: an workspace_admin may delete any of the workspace's
documents; a member may delete only their own uploads. If ANY requested id
is outside the workspace or not deletable by the caller, the whole batch is
rejected with 403 — no silent partial success that would mislead the caller.
Storage references are released transactionally and RAG `document_chunks` drop via
the FK `ON DELETE CASCADE`.
Synchronously rebuild a document's RAG index.

get.description:
Read a bounded slice of the converted markdown. Legacy pending documents
are processed synchronously on first read; ``wait_ms`` remains available for
a concurrent request already holding the document advisory lock. ``state``
distinguishes ``ready`` content, in-progress work, and persisted failure.
